- **Price per pound or serving**: the 5-pound tub at PriceSmart almost always wins; divide before comparing.

## Where it pays off

PriceSmart in Tegucigalpa and San Pedro Sula has the big tubs at the best per-pound price; Farmacia Siman and Walmart, small sizes and bars.
